cases.reason: No approved progressive JPEG encoder exists in the verified environment; a hand-built progressive stream would need unapproved encoder logic.
Same progressive-encoder gap as progressive_256; the class stays NOT_RUN instead of being dropped.

limitations: WIC and GDI+ share the installed Windows JPEG codec; agreement is differential, not absolute proof.
GDI+ has no pre-materialization admission and no boundary hold, so its lifetime and memory stay NOT_MEASURED.
WIC process counters are whole-process observations under an artificial hold.
Progressive and any sampling class without an approved encoder stay NOT_RUN.
A truncated JPEG decodes in both candidates and remains NOT_VERIFIED without a reference.
